review_comment: Potential Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in json_dumps filter: The new implementation directly outputs data without proper context-aware escaping. This can lead to XSS attacks when user-controlled data is included in the JavaScript output.

Potential Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in json_dumps filter: QuerySets are serialized but without proper escaping of user-controllable data which could lead to XSS when outputting the results.
